verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own site states that users can connect their favorite tools in just a few clicks, with new integrations added constantly. It also names integrations as a feedback channel and lists Slack, Discord and email as connected support channels. Support rests on marketing claims only. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of supported third-party integrations (e.g., issue trackers, CRMs), step-by-step setup docs showing the few-click flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect common third-party tools to my feedback workspace in just a few clicks

citations.quote: Connect Featurebase with your favorite tools in just a few clicks, with new integrations added constantly.
Centralize insights to a single source of truth with a feedback portal, in-app widgets, and integrations.
Support customers wherever they are: In-app, Slack, Discord, Emails, and more from a single powerful inbox.
